## What's Changed

- Adds movie and TV artwork and metadata management to the Local Media library, including full-library All and Missing views, title search, coverage totals, bulk matching, and per-title rematching for incorrect posters.
- Uses existing Emby/Jellyfin-compatible artwork and NFO sidecars first, then optionally fills missing movie and TV details through TMDB without replacing existing files during automatic scans.
- Adds compatible album and artist NFO support for music libraries while continuing to use embedded and folder artwork before MusicBrainz, Cover Art Archive, and TheAudioDB fallbacks.
- Saves newly matched artwork and metadata beside media whenever the library is writable, allowing Tater Tube, Emby, and Jellyfin to share the same sidecars.
- Keeps existing Discovery artwork sources and adds a server fallback for catalog entries that arrive without artwork.
- Adds server-backed progress for library scans, duration checks, artwork matching, and metadata generation. Active work remains visible after refreshing or changing pages and also appears on the dashboard.
- Refreshes the server interface with modern typography, clearer charcoal card surfaces, a simplified top bar, and the leaning Tater Tube mascot wordmark in the sidebar.

## Upgrade

Pull the latest container and restart:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/tatertotterson/tater-tube-server:latest
docker restart tater-tube-server
```

No configuration migration is required. Existing players and libraries remain compatible; TMDB matching is optional and stays disabled until a TMDB API key or read access token is saved.
